sources.note: Nothing. Phonology ch. 1.2 (pp. 5-17) covers vowels, consonants, semi-vowel and 'Tons et syllabes' (pp. 14-17): two level tones H/B plus falling and rising contours, lexical and grammatical tone, tone rules, open syllables. No mention of accent/stress/intensité/proéminence anywhere in the 122 scanned pages (a full-text search for stress/accent) and none in the tone section read from the page images.
